description: Wulfgard (P5, Rational Farewell, no gear) with Fluorite vs Rhodagn; he starts with his ultimate charged. Ultimate: forced Combustion at frame 45 (Scorching Fangs, Heat DMG +30%, on all five hits; P5 resets the combo). Battle skill on the Combusted enemy: the 31 -> 118 jump, the additional shot (8.5 x ATK) at 1.8 s consumes Combustion, returns 20 SP and (P3) refreshes Fangs and gives Fluorite 15%. Plain battle skill: the final shot's Heat opens his combo, MarkCanInterrupt frees him at 1.6 s; the combo's Heat on Heat bursts a second later (Rational Farewell's ATK from then on). Fluorite's Nature and his next combo form Combustion (Rational Farewell on the grenade itself), then the basic chain.
